prior_information: Unrestricted mean-target result and existing operator diagnostics known; lower-only selector not yet evaluated. Separate authorized feasibility check, not a change to prior result.
mapping: Use sealed float64 score vectors from the prior comparison. lower_only = minimum(Q1, mean_native_target), mathematically Q1 - maximum(Q1-mean_native_target,0). Coefficient fixed1. No new means, draws, normalization or model evaluations.
mapping_identity_check: Compare minimum form to subtraction form within64*eps64*(1+abs(q1)+abs(target)+abs(score)); assert every score<=Q1 exactly. Selection uses minimum form.
bank: Exact128 existing states by9 candidates, original order; both64state development batches and all15 original strata. No fitting or confirmation data.
controls: Reuse previously verified Q1, twin_min, actor and unrestricted mean_native_target control scores/selections/outcomes unchanged; compute only lower_only new selector.

selection_ties.rule: Lowest original index with abs(score-max(score))<=1e-6+1e-6*abs(max(score)); no recentering or V-based tiebreak. Reuse verified select helper.

value_ties: 1e-6+1e-6*max(abs(V_lower_only),abs(V_Q1)); improve delta>band, harm delta<-band, otherwise inconclusive.
primary_screen: PASS only if mean paired V gain lower_only vs Q1 > mean symmetric numerical band in BOTH development batches. Exploratory numerical direction screen, not significance or superiority.
stop_rule: If either batch fails, STOP proposing fit of this specific nonnegative penalty. Do not tune mapping, coefficient, draws or thresholds; no expanded diagnostics. If both pass, propose only one minimal cross-batch logged-offline-transition label-fitting pilot; do not fit. The evaluator-derived candidate labels are privileged and cannot be used as evidence of offline deployability; calibration requires separate justification.
outcomes: Reuse existing 15-stratum summary definitions: mean selected V, gainvsQ1/actor, best-of9 regret, switch/help/harm/inconclusive counts and magnitudes, numerical ambiguities. No new metric families, uncertainty resampling or fitted models.
selection_seal: Write and hash lower_only score/selection record before reading previous STATE_OUTCOMES.json saved values for this check. Prior diagnostics/outcomes known; not blind confirmation.
